news.title: North Sea, Europe
news.body: Our North Sea project involves offshore marine survey and inspection services in support of ongoing energy and commercial maritime operations. The team is conducting technical inspections, condition assessments, and compliance verification to help clients maintain high operational and safety standards throughout the project lifecycle.

news.title: Asia Region
news.body: We are actively engaged in a marine survey project in Asia, providing inspection services for commercial vessels and port-related operations. The project focuses on operational safety, technical reporting, and quality assurance while supporting clients with timely and accurate survey documentation throughout the assignment.

news.title: Alaska, North America
news.body: Our team is currently supporting a marine inspection and offshore survey project in Alaska. The assignment includes vessel condition assessments, cargo operation monitoring, and compliance inspections to ensure safe and efficient marine operations in challenging environmental conditions. Work is progressing on schedule with close coordination between our surveyors and local project partners.

team.name: Kelly Malik
team.bio: Kelly Malik is a dedicated Marine Survey Contractor who supports field operations across offshore, port, and vessel inspection projects. He works closely with project teams to carry out marine inspections, condition assessments, and on-site reporting. Kelly is recognized for his professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering accurate and dependable survey results.

team.name: Westin Giannis
team.bio: Westin Giannis leads our marine surveying operations with a strong focus on quality assurance, technical accuracy, and operational efficiency. He oversees survey planning, project execution, and client coordination across a wide range of marine and offshore assignments. Weston is committed to delivering reliable inspection services while ensuring every project meets international industry standards and client expectations.

team.name: Tony Kalfman
team.bio: Tony Kalfman serves as a Marine Surveyor Consultant Specialist, providing technical guidance and expert support for complex marine survey projects. He assists with risk assessments, compliance reviews, inspection planning, and project consultation for clients worldwide. His analytical approach and commitment to quality help ensure every project is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest professional standards.
